recipes.name: Galbijjim (Braised Short Ribs)
recipes.description: Soy-braised fall-off rib with radish and jujube.

steps.instruction: Blanch ribs; rinse.
Braise in sauce 90 min; add veg 40.
Reduce lacquer; sesame crown.

recipes.name: Yukgaejang
recipes.description: Fiery shredded-beef and fernbrake soup, scarlet with gochugaru oil.

steps.instruction: Simmer brisket 60 min; shred; keep broth.
Fry gochugaru in beef fat; broth back.
Vegetables 20 min; scallion blizzard.

videos.videoTitle: Spicy beef and vegetable soup (Yukgaejang: 육개장)

recipes.name: Bulgogi Jeongol
recipes.description: Hotpot of marinated beef, mushrooms, noodles in rich broth.

steps.instruction: Arrange beautifully in jeongol pot.
Broth over; simmer tableside 15 min.
Noodles last; slurp together.

recipes.name: Galbi
recipes.description: Marinated beef short ribs grilled over charcoal

steps.instruction: Score ribs in a crosshatch pattern.
Marinate in soy sauce, sugar, pear puree, garlic, and sesame oil.
Refrigerate overnight.
Grill over charcoal until caramelized and charred.

videos.videoTitle: The Only LA Kalbi Recipe You'll Ever Need | Esther Choi's Secret to Perfect Korean BBQ Short Ribs

recipes.name: Samgyeopsal
recipes.description: Thick pork belly slices grilled and wrapped in lettuce

steps.instruction: Heat a grill pan until smoking.
Cook pork belly slices until golden and crispy.
Wrap a piece in lettuce with garlic, ssamjang, and kimchi.
Eat in one bite.

recipes.name: Jjajangmyeon
recipes.description: Black bean sauce noodles a Korean-Chinese classic

steps.instruction: Fry diced pork belly until crispy.
Add black bean paste and fry until fragrant.
Add diced vegetables and stir-fry.
Serve over boiled noodles with julienned cucumber.

recipes.name: Kimchi Jjigae
recipes.description: Bubbling kimchi stew with pork and tofu

steps.instruction: Stir-fry pork belly with aged kimchi.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Add tofu cubes and gochugaru.
Simmer 15 minutes until flavors meld.

recipes.name: Seolleongtang
recipes.description: Milky ox bone soup with sliced beef and noodles

steps.instruction: Boil ox bones for 8 hours until broth is milky white.
Cook beef brisket in the broth until tender.
Slice beef thinly.
Serve broth with noodles, sliced beef, and scallions.

videos.videoTitle: Seolleongtang | The Most COMFORTING Korean Ox Bone Soup

recipes.name: Bossam
recipes.description: Boiled pork belly wraps served with condiments

steps.instruction: Boil pork belly with ginger, garlic, and soy sauce.
Cook until tender, about 1 hour.
Slice into thin pieces.
Wrap in napa cabbage with ssamjang, garlic, and kimchi.

recipes.name: Tteok Galbi
recipes.description: Ground beef short rib patties grilled with glaze

steps.instruction: Grind beef with onion and garlic.
Mix with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, and pear puree.
Shape into oval patties.
Grill over medium heat, brushing with glaze.

recipes.name: Naengmyeon
recipes.description: Icy buckwheat noodles in tangy cold broth

steps.instruction: Cook buckwheat noodles, rinse in ice water.
Slice boiled beef brisket thinly.
Pour icy beef broth over noodles.
Top with beef, cucumber, pear, egg, vinegar, and mustard.

recipes.name: Donggeurang Ttaeng
recipes.description: Korean egg-stuffed meatballs in broth

steps.instruction: Mix ground meats with crumbled tofu, egg, and seasonings.
Shape into round balls.
Pan-fry until golden.
Simmer in anchovy broth with vegetables.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.description: Tangy kimchi fried rice with pork and egg

steps.instruction: Stir-fry diced pork belly until crispy.
Add chopped kimchi and gochujang.
Add cold rice and stir-fry until coated.
Top with fried egg and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Galbitang
recipes.description: Clear beef short rib soup with tender meat and radish

steps.instruction: Blanch beef ribs and rinse clean.
Simmer ribs with radish onion and garlic for one hour.
Season with salt and sesame oil garnish with green onion.

recipes.name: Kongnamul Jjigae
recipes.description: Hearty soybean sprout stew with pork and chili

steps.instruction: Stir-fry pork belly with garlic until browned.
Add soybean sprouts and water bring to a boil.
Season with gochugaru and doenjang serve with rice.

recipes.name: Miyeokguk
recipes.description: Traditional Korean seaweed soup with beef

steps.instruction: Soak dried wakame seaweed and drain.
Stir-fry beef with garlic and sesame oil.
Add water and seaweed simmer twenty minutes season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Kimchi Veg
recipes.description: Vegan aged kimchi made without fish sauce

steps.instruction: Salt cabbage and let wilt for two hours.
Mix gochugaru garlic ginger and sugar into a paste.
Massage paste into cabbage with green onion pack in jar and ferment.

recipes.name: Doenjang Jjigae Veg
recipes.description: Vegan fermented soybean paste stew with vegetables

steps.instruction: Saute onion and mushroom with doenjang paste.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Add zucchini and tofu simmer ten minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Kongnamul Beans
recipes.description: Seasoned soybean sprout and bean side dish

steps.instruction: Blanch soybean sprouts and soybeans until tender.
Drain well and toss with sesame oil and garlic.
Season with salt and green onion serve as banchan.

recipes.name: Gyeran Sujeol
recipes.description: Seasoned shredded egg strips for rice bowls

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with salt and green onion.
Cook thin omelette in a non-stick pan.
Shred into strips and serve over warm rice.

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken (Yangnyeom)
recipes.description: Double-fried crackle glazed in sweet-spicy gochujang sauce.

steps.instruction: Fry 160°C 8 min; rest.
Refry 185°C 3 min extra-crisp.
Warm sauce tumble-glaze.

videos.videoTitle: The BEST Korean Fried Chicken Recipe EVER! Crispy Chicken

recipes.name: Dakgalbi
recipes.description: Gochujang chicken stir-fried with cabbage, tteok and cheese option.

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken 1 hour.
Big pan stir-fry veg first then chicken.
Cheese ring melt finish; rice cakes chewy.

recipes.name: Samgyetang
recipes.description: Whole young chicken stuffed with rice, ginseng and jujube - summer health soup.

steps.instruction: Stuff cavities rice-ginseng-jujube; tie legs.
Boil gently 70-90 min till spoon-tender.
Pepper-salt dip alongside; broth sips.

recipes.name: Dakdoritang
recipes.description: Spicy braised chicken with potatoes in glossy gochujang stew.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken; aromatics soft.
Sauce + water; braise covered 35 min.
Reduce glaze; scallion finish.

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
recipes.description: Double-fried crispy chicken with spicy or soy glaze

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in garlic, soy, and ginger.
Coat in flour-cornstarch mix.
Deep-fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest, then fry at 190C.
Toss with gochujang glaze or serve with pickled radish.

recipes.name: Dakjjim
recipes.description: Braised chicken with vegetables in soy-garlic sauce

steps.instruction: Brown chicken pieces.
Add soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and water.
Add potatoes, carrots, and mushrooms.
Braise for 30 minutes until sauce reduces.

recipes.name: Buldak
recipes.description: Fire chicken in extreme gochujang and gochugaru sauce

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Mix gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Stir-fry chicken with sauce until cooked.
Drizzle sesame oil, serve with rice.

recipes.name: Andong Jjimdak
recipes.description: Soy-braised chicken with glass noodles and vegetables

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in soy sauce and sugar.
Add water, garlic, and dried chili.
Add potatoes, carrots, and braise for 20 minutes.
Add soaked glass noodles and cook until done.

recipes.name: Chicken Gangjeong
recipes.description: Sweet and crispy bite-sized chicken pieces

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Coat in flour-cornstarch and deep-fry until crispy.
Mix soy sauce, honey, and garlic for glaze.
Toss fried chicken in glaze with crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Dakbal
recipes.description: Spicy chicken feet in gochujang glaze

steps.instruction: Boil chicken feet until very tender.
Mix gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Toss feet in sauce.
Grill or broil briefly until slightly charred.

recipes.name: Dakbokkeumtang
recipes.description: Spicy braised chicken with potatoes and carrots

steps.instruction: Cut chicken and vegetables into bite-size pieces.
Braise chicken with gochujang and soy sauce broth.
Add potatoes and carrots cook until tender and serve.

recipes.name: Tori-dang
recipes.description: Sweet and spicy glazed chicken with crispy coating

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in soy and garlic.
Pan-fry chicken until golden and crispy.
Toss in gochujang corn syrup glaze and top with sesame.

recipes.name: Dakkkochi
recipes.description: Grilled spicy chicken skewers with scallion

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken with gochujang and soy sauce.
Thread chicken and green onion onto skewers.
Grill over medium heat basting with remaining marinade.

recipes.name: Chogyejjim
recipes.description: Braised whole chicken with garlic and vegetables

steps.instruction: Blanch whole chicken and rinse clean.
Braise chicken in soy sauce with garlic and ginger for one hour.
Garnish with sliced egg and green onion serve hot.

recipes.name: Chueotang
recipes.description: Spicy loach soup with perilla powder and vegetables

steps.instruction: Clean and blanch loach set aside.
Make broth with perilla powder garlic and gochugaru.
Add loach zucchini and tofu simmer twenty minutes.

recipes.name: Soondubu Jjim
recipes.description: Spicy soft tofu casserole steamed with mixed seafood

steps.instruction: Place soft tofu in a hot stone pot.
Add seafood and gochugaru broth on top.
Bring to a boil and serve with green onion and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Doenjang Jjigae
recipes.description: Fermented soybean paste stew with tofu and vegetables

steps.instruction: Saute onion and potato with doenjang paste.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Add zucchini and tofu simmer ten minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Budae Jjigae
recipes.description: Hearty army stew with mixed meats ramen and melted cheese in spicy broth

steps.instruction: Cook spam and kimchi in a pot with broth.
Add gochujang tofu and ramen noodles.
Top with cheese and green onion serve boiling hot.

recipes.name: Kkakdugi
recipes.description: Cubed radish kimchi spicy and crunchy

steps.instruction: Cut radish into small cubes.
Mix gochugaru with fish sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Toss radish cubes in seasoning.
Pack into a jar and ferment 2 days at room temp.

recipes.name: Hobak Jorim
recipes.description: Braised zucchini in soy sauce

steps.instruction: Cut zucchini into half-moons.
Braise in soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and water.
Cook until tender but not mushy.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Bulgogi
recipes.description: Pear-marinated grilled beef ribbons - Korea's signature.

steps.instruction: Marinate 3+ hours.
Griddle ripping hot till caramelized.
Scallions + sesame; wrap in lettuce.

recipes.name: Chicken Bibimbap
recipes.description: Warm rice bowl topped with seasoned chicken, vegetables and gochujang.

ingredients.name: Seasoned namul: spinach, bean sprout, mushroom, carrot, zucchini

steps.instruction: Season each vegetable separately (namul method).
Fan over hot rice in sections.
Gochujang + sesame; mix violently before eating.

videos.videoTitle: Restaurant-Style Bibimbap! Simple & Delicious at Home!

recipes.name: Japchae
recipes.description: Sweet-potato glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables and sesame.

steps.instruction: Boil noodles chewy; scissors-shorten.
Season noodles in wok with sauce.
Fold vegetables; sesame finish.

videos.videoTitle: FAILPROOF Authentic JAPCHAE Recipe + DELICIOUS Japchae Dumplings 🥟 초간단 잡채 + 🥟잡채만두 [チャプチェ]

recipes.name: Tteokbokki
recipes.description: Chewy rice cakes in sweet-hot gochujang gravy - street royalty.

steps.instruction: Dissolve paste in stock; boil.
Tteok in; simmer 12-15 min to saucy.
Reduce clingy; sesame.

recipes.name: Kimchijeon (Kimchi Pancake)
recipes.description: Crisp-edged kimchi pancakes with soy-vinegar dip.

ingredients.name: Pancake batter (flour + rice flour + kimchi brine)

steps.instruction: Mix batter loose; kimchi through.
Oil-shallow fry medium-high till lacy edges crisp.
Flip once; dip soy-vinegar.

videos.videoTitle: How to make crispy kimchi pancake (Kimchijeon 김치전)

recipes.name: Kalguksu
recipes.description: Knife-cut noodle soup with seafood and vegetables

steps.instruction: Make dough from flour, egg, and salt; roll and cut into strips.
Bring anchovy broth to a boil.
Add vegetables and clams.
Add noodles and cook until done.

recipes.name: Sundubu Jjigae
recipes.description: Soft tofu stew with seafood and gochugaru

steps.instruction: Heat sesame oil and fry garlic.
Add gochugaru and stir.
Add broth, clams, and soft tofu.
Bring to a boil, crack egg on top, serve bubbling.

recipes.name: Haemul Pajeon
recipes.description: Seafood scallion pancake crispy on the outside

steps.instruction: Mix flour and water into a thin batter.
Lay scallions and seafood on a hot oiled pan.
Pour batter over and cook until crispy.
Flip and cook the other side. Serve with soy dip.

recipes.name: Jokbal
recipes.description: Braised pig's feet served sliced with lettuce wraps

steps.instruction: Blanch pig feet and clean.
Braise in soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, and star anise for 2 hours.
Remove and slice.
Serve with lettuce, ssamjang, and garlic.

recipes.name: Gyeran Jjim
recipes.description: Steamed egg custard fluffy and savory

steps.instruction: Beat eggs with anchovy broth and salt.
Pour into a heated earthenware pot.
Cook over low heat, stirring gently.
Cover and steam until fluffy and set.

recipes.name: Yachae Bokkeum
recipes.description: Stir-fried mixed vegetables in sesame

steps.instruction: Julienne all vegetables.
Heat sesame oil and sauté garlic.
Add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Season with soy sauce and sesame seeds.

videos.videoTitle: Yachae bokkeum a Korean-style stirfry mixed vegetables

recipes.name: Kongnamul Muchim
recipes.description: Seasoned bean sprout side dish

steps.instruction: Blanch bean sprouts for 2 minutes.
Drain and cool.
Season with sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and green onion.
Toss with sesame seeds.

videos.videoTitle: Easy Korean Seasoned Soybean Sprouts (Kongnamul Muchim) | Healthy Korean Side Dish Recipe 🇰🇷

recipes.name: Sigeumchi Namul
recipes.description: Seasoned spinach side dish

steps.instruction: Blanch spinach for 30 seconds.
Squeeze out excess water.
Season with sesame oil, soy sauce, garlic, and green onion.
Garnish with sesame seeds.

videos.videoTitle: How to: Sigeumchi Namul | Korean Spinach Side Dish!

recipes.name: Bibim Guksu
recipes.description: Spicy cold noodles with vegetables

steps.instruction: Cook noodles, rinse in cold water.
Julienne cucumber and tomato.
Mix gochujang, vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil.
Toss noodles with sauce and vegetables.

recipes.name: Gamja Jorim
recipes.description: Soy-braised baby potatoes

steps.instruction: Boil baby potatoes until just tender.
Stir-fry with soy sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Cook until sauce glazes the potatoes.
Finish with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Gim Bap
recipes.description: Seaweed rice rolls with vegetables and egg

steps.instruction: Season rice with sesame oil and salt.
Blanch spinach, julienne carrot, cook egg strips.
Lay nori, spread rice, arrange fillings.
Roll tightly and slice into rounds.

recipes.name: Haemul Ttukbaegi
recipes.description: Bubbling seafood stew in stone pot

steps.instruction: Heat anchovy broth with gochugaru.
Add clams and cook until they open.
Add shrimp and tofu.
Crack egg on top and serve bubbling.

recipes.name: Vegetable Japchae
recipes.description: Glass noodles stir-fried with colorful vegetables

steps.instruction: Soak glass noodles in warm water.
Stir-fry each vegetable separately.
Combine with noodles, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Toss everything together and serve.

recipes.name: Kimchi Jeon
recipes.description: Crispy kimchi pancake

steps.instruction: Mix chopped kimchi with flour and water.
Add green onion slices.
Pan-fry in oil until crispy on both sides.
Serve with soy-vinegar dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Dubu Kimchi
recipes.description: Pan-fried tofu with spicy kimchi

steps.instruction: Pan-fry tofu slices until golden.
Stir-fry kimchi with garlic and gochugaru.
Serve kimchi over tofu.
Drizzle with sesame oil.

recipes.name: Patbingsu
recipes.description: Shaved ice mountain with red beans, condensed milk and mochi.

steps.instruction: Shave frozen-milk into snow.
Beans + fruit + mochi landscape.
Condensed monsoon; eat fast.

videos.videoTitle: Patbingsu (Shaved ice with sweet red beans and fruit)

recipes.name: Hotteok
recipes.description: Griddled cinnamon-brown-sugar stuffed pancakes.

steps.instruction: Rise dough 1h; portion balls.
Flatten cup; filling in; seal; flatten again.
Griddle oiled both sides till mahogany; caution lava.

recipes.name: Bingsu
recipes.description: Shaved ice dessert with sweet toppings

steps.instruction: Freeze milk into a solid block.
Shave into fluffy ice.
Top with sweet red beans, mochi, and fruit.
Drizzle with condensed milk.

videos.videoTitle: Authentic Bingsu Recipe (빙수) 🍧 | Easy Korean Shaved Ice Dessert 🇰🇷

recipes.name: Hangwa
recipes.description: Traditional Korean rice cookie and confection

steps.instruction: Mix rice flour with honey and form dough.
Shape into small pieces.
Coat with sesame seeds or pine nuts.
Deep-fry or bake until crispy.

recipes.name: Yugwa
recipes.description: Puffed rice snack coated in flower honey and nut powder

steps.instruction: Mix puffed rice with rice syrup.
Shape into small bars.
Coat in honey and roll in peanut powder.
Let cool and harden.

recipes.name: Songpyeon
recipes.description: Half-moon rice cakes filled with sesame and honey

steps.instruction: Mix rice flour with hot water and knead into dough.
Fill dough with sesame honey mixture and shape into half moons.
Steam over pine needles for twenty minutes until glossy.

recipes.name: Yakgwa
recipes.description: Honey-glazed deep-fried rice cookies

steps.instruction: Mix flour with honey sesame oil and ginger juice.
Shape dough into small flower-shaped pieces.
Deep fry until golden and soak in honey syrup.

recipes.name: Sujeonggwa
recipes.description: Korean cinnamon punch with dried persimmon

steps.instruction: Boil cinnamon and ginger in water for thirty minutes.
Strain and add sugar to taste let cool.
Serve chilled with dried persimmon and pine nuts.

recipes.name: Dasik
recipes.description: Traditional pressed tea confection with patterns

steps.instruction: Mix rice flour with honey and sugar into a stiff dough.
Press into traditional wooden molds to form shapes.
Arrange on plate and serve with tea.

recipes.name: Jeonggwa
recipes.description: Sweet candied ginger and fruit preserve

steps.instruction: Peel and slice ginger into thin strips.
Boil ginger in sugar water until translucent.
Add honey cool and store in syrup.
